name: public-lockfile
summary: Re-resolve the app lockfile against the public npm registry
body:
The original lockfile was generated behind an internal registry
mirror (bnpm.byted.org), unreachable from CI runners — npm ci died on
ENOTFOUND (and tripped npm 10's exit-handler bug on the way). The
lockfile now pins registry.npmjs.org URLs with integrity hashes for
every package; versions are unchanged.
